D/ [--]IVL CONSTANTIVS NOB C ; R/ GLOR IA EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 336-340, Reece period 17, Lyon mint. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]IVL CONSTANTIVS NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA EXERC ITVS. In exergue: PLG. Diameter: 11.6mm, Weight: 0.62gms, die axis: 1
